page.seoDescription: Nifty AI is the AI website builder from Nifty Marketing Australia — fast, secure, lead-ready websites for small business, built by AI and perfected by you.

props.label: Smarter websites, the way they should be
props.html:
Home · About

Smarter websites, the way they should be

Nifty AI comes from Nifty Marketing Australia — a team that got tired of watching small businesses pay for slow, fragile, plugin-stacked websites. So we built a better way.

props.label: We build the websites we wished existed
props.html:
Our story

We build the websites we wished existed

Most small-business websites are slow, fragile, and bolted together from a dozen paid plugins. Owners are scared to touch them, enquiries slip through broken forms, and every month brings another bill.

Nifty AI does it differently. You describe the business, AI builds a complete, on-brand site, and it’s published as lightning-fast static pages on Cloudflare’s global edge — with forms, SEO and lead capture built in. No plugins, no servers, no maintenance.

Every claim on this site is drawn from the real, shipped Nifty dashboard — so everything you see is genuine and demonstrable.

props.label: Four principles behind everything
props.html:
What we stand for

Four principles behind everything

AI-built, human-perfected

AI creates the whole site; you tweak anything in a live editor. The best of both.

Built to perform

Near-instant loads on Cloudflare’s global edge — better for people and for Google.

Everything included

Hosting, SSL, spam protection, SEO and email — one subscription, no plugin creep.

You’re in control

Own it, edit it yourself, and we handle the hosting, security and upkeep.
